Camila —

Thanks; confirmed on my side for Tue 6/1 10:00 PT. A few internal asks to make the kickoff efficient:

- Please request HelixCloud provide: completed onboarding form (we have), W-9 (received), billing contact (Angela), and an initial PO estimate or anticipated monthly spend so we can size pooling/quotas.
- Legal: we should route the MPA draft to Legal prior to the call if possible for a quick review of non-standard terms (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps).
- Timeline/success criteria proposals (suggested):
  - Day 0: Kickoff call (6/1)
  - Day 3: Redwood & Helix agree on MAP responsibilities + finance sends PO estimate
  - Day 10: Contract countersigned; PO issued
  - Day 14–21: Staging keys & test access; integration validation
  - Target go-live: Day 30 from kickoff

- Success criteria (must-haves): PO issued + valid invoice flow, staging access validated, basic perf smoke tests passed.

I’ll draft those milestones in the MAP doc and share a link before the call. Priyom — please be ready to capture the technical owners and any whitelist/IP requirements during the kickoff.

Vivek
